name: an-array-of-three-is-three-forwards
description: A neuron with `each` answers an array of three (2.4, 4.4): one answer with the whole array, then one forward per item in the array's order, each a signal of its own on the same trace with the answer as its cause and the hops of any forward, delivered to every outgoing link; so three calls at each of b and c, replied in the order they were started.
